content:
As a young woman lawyer, I knew there would be no shortage of doubts, hesitations, or skeptics. But vision always speaks louder than hesitation and today, India Energy Law Association (India-ELA) is officially a reality.

I may be the Founder, but the true strength of my story comes from the heroes who trusted my vision and never questioned me, standing firmly behind it to make this landmark launch possible. 

Buddy Ranganadhan (Senior Advocate), Dr. SANJEEV GEMAWAT (MD & Group General Counsel, Essar Group), Dr. Akhil Prasad (Group General Counsel, Boeing), Vishrov Mukerjee (Partner, Trilegal), Yashaswi Kant Kant (Counsel, Trilegal), Ratan K. Singh (Senior Advocate), and Akshay Gandotra, LL.M.Gandotra (Joint Secretary, Society of Construction Law - India) for lending their immense expertise, time, support, and guidance to bring this vision to life.

Here’s to breaking barriers, building platforms, and driving the future of energy law together! To every young lawyer, especially every young woman with a bold dream, let this be proof that your voice belongs at the table, your vision is valid, and the right people will stand behind you to build it. Onward and upward!

 ✨
